name: Conjoint Analysis
when_to_use: Product/service described by combinable attributes and levels; respondents rate combinations; decompose total preference into the contribution of each attribute.
notes: Decomposes customer preference for a product into the contributions of each characteristic (price, brand, color). Applications: decide which attribute combination maximizes purchase intent.

expected_input.question: How much does each attribute of a product contribute to customer preference?

plain_explanation.purpose: Discovers what people value most in a product, from choices among bundles.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you need to know how much price, brand or lead time weigh in the purchase decision.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Answers from people ranking or choosing among attribute combinations.
plain_explanation.example: Find out whether the customer prefers to pay less or receive sooner.
plain_explanation.diagram: bundle A (cheap, slow) vs. bundle B (expensive, fast) -> weight of each attribute
